questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: If 3x + 5 = 20, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Subtract 5 from both sides to get 3x = 15, then divide both sides by 3. Therefore, x = 5.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: The sum of the roots of 2x² - 8x + 3 = 0 is:
questions.explanation: For ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of the roots is -b/a. Here it is -(-8)/2 = 4.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: If y varies directly as x and y = 18 when x = 6, find y when x = 11.
questions.explanation: Direct variation gives y = kx. Since 18 = 6k, k = 3. When x = 11, y = 3 × 11 = 33.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: Solve simultaneously: x + y = 9 and x - y = 3.
questions.explanation: Add the equations to get 2x = 12, so x = 6. Substituting into x + y = 9 gives y = 3.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: Find the highest common factor of 36, 48 and 60.
questions.explanation: The common factors include 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12. The greatest of these is 12.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: A trader increases a price of ₦8,000 by 15%. What is the new price?
questions.explanation: 15% of ₦8,000 is ₦1,200. Adding the increase gives ₦9,200.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: The angles of a triangle are 2x, 3x and 4x. Find x.
questions.explanation: Angles in a triangle sum to 180°. Thus 2x + 3x + 4x = 9x = 180°, so x = 20°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a circle of radius 7 cm, taking π = 22/7.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: A right-angled triangle has shorter sides of 6 cm and 8 cm. Find its hypotenuse.
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, c² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100. Therefore c = 10 cm.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.text: The volume of a cuboid measuring 8 cm by 5 cm by 3 cm is:
questions.explanation: Volume of a cuboid is length × width × height: 8 × 5 × 3 = 120 cm³.
